post.summary: Rebuild every session's derived rows from its stored events
Rebuild one session's derived rows from its stored events
post.description:
Replay the stored stream through the current derivation.

Stages, lanes and assets are derived, so a fix to how they are derived does
nothing for a run already recorded until its events are replayed. Idempotent:
the derived rows are dropped and rebuilt, never updated. The event stream
itself is never touched — it is the record this rebuilds from.

the run's evidence — kept as sibling arrays keyed by `phase_id`.

baseline_tokens.title: Baseline Tokens
baseline_tokens.description: The first main-lane sample's total — preamble plus first prompt.

sidechain_samples.title: Sidechain Samples

tools.title: Tools

ContextToolCost.description: One tool's share of a session's context growth, main lane only.

path.title: Path

parent.title: Parent

home.title: Home

DriftStatus.description: How the installed copy relates to what was installed and to upstream.

status.title: Status
status.description: The status it declared: ok | blocked | failed.

raw_text.title: Raw Text
raw_text.description: The reply it was read out of — often the only body a rejection has.

origin.title: Origin

EnvelopeAttempt.title: EnvelopeAttempt
EnvelopeAttempt.description: One envelope an agent returned, and whether the runner could read it.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role that produced it; else the event's lane.

attempt.description: 1-based try within (stage, role); counted for you when omitted.

parsed.title: Parsed
parsed.description: Did it parse? Defaults to `parse_error` being absent.

status.title: Status
status.description: The status it declared: ok | blocked | failed.

body.title: Body
body.description: The envelope object as returned; truncated past 32 KB serialized.

raw_text.title: Raw Text
raw_text.description: The reply the envelope was read out of — the only body a rejected attempt has. Truncated past 32 KB with a marker saying so.

EnvelopeIn.title: EnvelopeIn
EnvelopeIn.description: The envelope an agent returned on one attempt, as the runner read it.

project_path.title: Project Path
project_path.description: The project the run worked on.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: The preset the run used, e.g. "scout".

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the run ended, e.g. 'cost cap reached…'.

resumable.title: Resumable
resumable.description: True when a resume would be accepted: not live, not completed-accepted.

resume_hint.title: Resume Hint
resume_hint.description: Why a resume is not offered; null when `resumable` is true.

dismissed.title: Dismissed
dismissed.description: The user waved this run away; it is out of the way, not gone.

superseded_by.title: Superseded By
superseded_by.description: Run id of a newer run of this same request, when one exists.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: What this run's last stage concluded, from its own telemetry.

check.description: The newest check started for this run, if any.

session_ids.title: Session Ids
session_ids.description: Coding sessions this run's stages reported.

FactoryRun.title: FactoryRun
FactoryRun.description:
One run.json under a project's runs root — the factory's ground truth,
independent of whether the run was launched from this UI or a terminal.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: What it concluded; null while it runs.

FactoryRunCheck.title: FactoryRunCheck
FactoryRunCheck.description: A read-only run started to answer whether another run's work landed.

project_path.title: Project Path
project_path.description: Absolute path; must resolve under projects_root.

project_path.description: Absolute path; must resolve under projects_root.

item.description: The thing checked — a path, a command.

note.title: Note
note.description: What the check wrote. The payload that matters.

GateCheckIn.title: GateCheckIn
GateCheckIn.description:
One item a gate checked. Any field it leaves out is taken from the gate
block around it, so a gate with a single verdict needs no entry at all.

phase_id.title: Phase Id
phase_id.description: The stage it ran in; join on it.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: The gate that ran. `stage` is the catch-all for a verdict that named none.

item.title: Item
item.description: The thing checked; null for a whole-gate verdict.

note.title: Note
note.description: What the check wrote. The reason this row exists.

GateCheckItem.title: GateCheckItem
GateCheckItem.description: One check a gate ran, and the sentence it wrote.

GateFailureNote.title: GateFailureNote
GateFailureNote.description: One distinct sentence a gate wrote when it said no.

name.title: Name
name.description: The gate that ran — envelope, artifacts, changed_files, boundary, …

attempt.title: Attempt
attempt.description: 1-based try within the stage; counted for you when omitted.

item.title: Item
item.description: Default item for the checks below.

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: Default verdict; else read off the event type.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: One entry per item checked. Omit for a single whole-gate verdict.

GateIn.title: GateIn
GateIn.description:
One gate evaluation as the runner reports it.

With `checks`, one row per entry; without it, the block is itself the one
check. `ok` falls back to the event type (`gate_pass` / `gate_fail`), so the
minimal report is `{"name": "changed_files", "note": "…"}` on the event a
runner already sends.

role.title: Role
role.description: The lane whose stage the check ran in; null when none was resolved.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Checks this pair ran — the rate's denominator.

failure_rate.title: Failure Rate
failure_rate.description: failures / checks. Null when no check ran, which is not the same as 0.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Distinct runs the pair was seen in.

GateRoleStat.title: GateRoleStat
GateRoleStat.description: One gate as one role experienced it.

failure_rate.title: Failure Rate
failure_rate.description: failures / checks; null when checks is 0.

by_role.title: By Role
by_role.description: The same numbers per role, failure rate first, then role.

top_failure_notes.title: Top Failure Notes
top_failure_notes.description: The failing notes, commonest first and capped at 5 per gate. A gate's note usually names the files it is about, so most counts are 1 and the list reads as the most recent distinct failures.

GateStat.title: GateStat
GateStat.description: One gate across every run: how often it ran, how often it failed, where.

event_type.title: Event Type
event_type.description: Hook name, e.g. "PreToolUse"; any string is accepted.

source.title: Source
source.description: Which agent's hooks sent this. Used on first sight only, and defaults to claude-code so a forwarder from before Codex was recorded still files its sessions where it always did.

cwd.title: Cwd
cwd.description: Working directory; used on first sight only.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id; the latest value wins.

tool_name.title: Tool Name
tool_name.description: Tool the event is about, when it is one.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: Free-form hook input; truncated past 32 KB serialized.

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: Free-form counters shallow-merged into the session's stats.

ended.title: Ended
ended.description: True on the last event of the session.

title.title: Title
title.description: The run's request; kept from the first one seen.

phase.description: Stage to upsert and link this event to.

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: Did the thing this event reports succeed?

duration_ms.title: Duration Ms
duration_ms.description: How long it took, when the hook knows.

envelope.description: The envelope this event's attempt returned, and whether it parsed.

gate.description: The gate this event reports, and the note each check wrote.

context_samples.title: Context Samples
context_samples.description: The context-usage curve since the previous Stop/SessionEnd.

HookEventRequest.title: HookEventRequest
HookEventRequest.description:
One hook firing. Deliberately permissive: everything but `session_id` and
`event_type` is optional, over-long values are truncated rather than
rejected, and an optional field whose value will not validate is dropped
rather than answered with a 422 — a hook never fails a Claude Code run,
including when the backend has moved on and it has not.

asset_id.title: Asset Id
asset_id.description: "claude:skill:<name>", the id the assets API also uses.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Link to the skill's folder on GitHub.

installed_sha.title: Installed Sha
installed_sha.description: Upstream commit for the folder at install time; null when unknown.

root_path.title: Root Path
root_path.description: Folder inside the repo the skill came from; "" for the repo root.

last_checked_at.title: Last Checked At
last_checked_at.description: When the upstream check last ran; null means never.

upstream_sha.title: Upstream Sha
upstream_sha.description: Upstream commit seen by the last check.

drift_status.description: Cached result of the last check; null until one has run.

path.title: Path
path.description: Absolute path to the global CLAUDE.md.

content.title: Content
content.description: Full markdown, "" when the file does not exist yet.

exists.title: Exists
exists.description: False when no file is on disk; a PUT creates it.

content.title: Content
content.description: Full new file content to write.

project_path.title: Project Path
project_path.description: Absolute path; must resolve under projects_root.

request_text.title: Request Text
request_text.description: What to build — handed to the factory as-is.

checks_run_id.title: Checks Run Id
checks_run_id.description: Run id this launch exists to check; ties a scout run to its subject.

workflow.description: Which stages run. Omitted means the factory's own default (full).

LaunchWorkflow.description:
The factory's stage presets (factory/adw/workflows.py). `scout` is the
cheap one: a single read-only stage that reads the repo and reports.

name.title: Name
name.description: Folder name — no path separators or traversal.

LauncherProjectCreateRequest.title: LauncherProjectCreateRequest
LauncherProjectCreateRequest.description:
Named apart from the unrelated `ProjectCreateRequest` (features/projects) —
this creates a plain folder under projects_root, not a masterwork Project.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model the lanes reported. Null is a real row rather than a gap, but it is not a model: it is every lane that named none — the pipeline's own `git` and `checks` lanes, which run no model at all and appear in every run, plus every agent lane recorded before the runner started sending one. Do not read it as a competitor to the named rows; a run appears under it and under its model both.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Distinct runs with at least one lane on this model.

acceptance_rate.title: Acceptance Rate
acceptance_rate.description: accepted_runs / runs. Read `runs` before believing it — a rate over two runs is noise, and masterwork will not hide it behind a threshold.

stages.description: Stages whose lane ran this model.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Summed over the lanes, not the stages.

gate_checks.title: Gate Checks
gate_checks.description: From the stage counters, as in RoleStat.

ModelStat.title: ModelStat
ModelStat.description: One model across every run that used it, through the lanes it ran.

label.title: Label
label.description: Agent name to show in the UI.

state.title: State
state.description: connected: recording. outdated: wired to an older hook set or a missing script — connect repairs it. disconnected: nothing installed. unavailable: cannot be connected on this machine; `detail` says why.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: One sentence for the user explaining the state.

ingest_url.title: Ingest Url
ingest_url.description: Where the agent's hooks post their events.

events.title: Events

field never clears what is already stored.

flow_mermaid.title: Flow Mermaid
flow_mermaid.description: Mermaid source: how the linked assets work together.

the COMPLETE new list of linked assets (not a delta).

Partial update. Only fields present in the request body are changed;
`flow_mermaid` is explicitly nullable (send null to clear the diagram).

new_content.title: New Content

envelope_attempts.description: Envelopes this role returned; 0 for a run that reported none.

active_ms.title: Active Ms

gate_checks.description: v1.19 evidence rows — 0 for a run that never reported or replayed any.

RunStat.description: One run as a point on a trend line.

launched.description: True once the subprocess was spawned.

summary.description: Markdown: what the simulated run did.

query_wiql.title: Query Wiql
query_wiql.description: Overrides the default assigned-to-me WIQL when set.
